written: 2026-10-24, after the identity check and before any seed-201/202 run. Amends protocol_amendment_seeds.json (gate only). UNAUDITED.
what_happened: The gate in protocol_amendment_seeds.json (max abs weight difference <= 1e-4 at step 25) FAILED: 5.86e-4, about equal to the whole step0->step25 drift (6.6e-4). Training was stopped (commit 258e4ed).
why_the_gate_is_replaced: GPU non-determinism (atomic scatter adds in message passing) changes gradients at the 1e-4 relative level; Adam's early updates are close to sign-like (about lr per step), so tiny gradient differences flip update signs and weights differ by an amount comparable to the total early movement. Losses over steps 1-25 diverge gradually (max relative 0.177 by step 25), the normal signature of a chaotic but same-setup run. The 1e-4 weight tolerance was set too tight for this; it does not measure setup identity.
approval: the owner's decision 'A is fine' (accept the looser identity check) was relayed by the hub/coordinator at 14:18 on 2026-10-24; I did not receive it from the owner directly.
new_check: PASS if (a) the resolved training config of the rerun is identical to the stored seed-200 config AND (b) the training losses at steps 1-6 agree within 1e-2 relative.

measured.config: experiments/b-continue/experiments/genco-retrain-cont/fixed/final/cfg.yaml vs the rerun's /tmp work cfg.yaml: diff empty (identical)

unchanged: everything else in protocol.json and protocol_amendment_seeds.json (seeds, arms, scoring, readouts, how the post sentence is updated). The weight-difference failure and the loss divergence to step 25 stay on the record and are reported with the seed results.
